## 15:10 UTC - Flat contrast and hero-card fidelity pipeline fixes

- Task: Work OS `80327069-f5fa-487c-8f0f-c5d127dc6ac6`, subtasks
  `2a3d2341-cfdf-4a20-8e07-c30d35e3b65e` and
  `93d57e9d-89d8-426a-a42d-f240d02c53dd`.
- Branch/worktree: `codex/launchloom-visual-followup` at
  `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-visual-followup`.
- Root cause of the 4.047 contrast failure: `planContrastRepairs` treated
  every `state: "focus"` finding as a focus indicator. A failing focus-state
  text finding therefore received an outline instead of a text color. The
  generated `:focus-visible` rule was also attached to the descendant span
  instead of the focused anchor, so it could never match.
- Added `scripts/flat-contrast-repair.mjs`: flat-pair parsing, WCAG contrast,
  hue-preserving darkening, and a bounded exact-token fallback. The bounded
  correction engine now repairs flat focus/hover text as a foreground color,
  scoped to the control that owns the state.
- Added `scripts/hero-card-contract.mjs`: route-scoped floating-copy
  detection, hero-copy coverage evidence, and a large-bordered-card finding.
  `run-creative-bakeoff.mjs` now records `heroCopyAreaRatio`,
  `heroCopyWidthRatio`, `heroCopyHeightRatio`, `heroCopyMobileAreaRatio`,
  `heroCopyHasBorder`, and `heroCopyHasOpaqueBackground`, and fails an
  image-led floating-copy route whose card exceeds the thresholds.
- Added `HERO_CARD_FIDELITY_REPAIR_GUIDANCE` and centralized targeted repair
  guidance. The authoring contract now tells floating-copy routes to use a
  compact scrim, not a bordered card.
- Validation so far: 281 focused tests passed, 9 hero-card tests passed,
  `npm run check` 0 errors and 0 warnings across 458 files. The
  creative-promotion suite is running.
